tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// mchod gtor bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje phur pa'i mchod gtor bsdus pa byed par 'dod pas/ sha khrag phud dang bcas pa'i gtor ma dpal dang bcas pa ci 'byor bshams la bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ngam/ oṃ ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ lnga las 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlab bo// oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ āḥlas byung ba'i phud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang rak+ta ram̐ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag tu byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du dbang phyug pho mo'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mtha' mar oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon dang po me dpung*/ bar pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis phur ba 'dril ba/ sku che zhing rags pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon dang*/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sprul gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa khrag 'dzag pas do shal byas pa/ skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ rak+ta'i thig le zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i cha lugs rdzogs pa'i brdar rin po ches brgyan pa'o// de nas rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched dang skra dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro bos gtams par bsam mo// rang 'dra ba de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' rang lta bu mtshon gang ba cig bsam/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje yungs 'bru tsam gyi lte ba la hūm̐ chung ngu cig bsams pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o// de la lha thams cad thim par bsams nas dbang bskur/

rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa de dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam ngo bor bsams pa'i ljags las 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ dbul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol// zhes pas 'dod yon lnga phul la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥshrī he ru ka i daṃ dhū paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha ho shrī ban+dha khā hi/ zhes pas dbul/ yang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas kyang mchod de lha thams cad dgyes nas ha ha ha zhes gsung bar bsam/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung nas bdag la byin gyis brlabs/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces pas dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral bar bsams la chos kyi dbyings su sangs rgyas par bsgom mo// de nas sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ thog mar bdag nyid rtog bsgom bsgral// de nas gnyis med blo yis ni// blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje// gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya// zhes pa dang*/ thabs dang shes rab bam/ zag pa med pa'i mchod pa ni/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba'i// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// pad+mo la ni rdo rje zhugs// bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par bya'o// sa ma ya ho// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ra go yaṃ a nu ra ga ya me/ bo dhi tsit+ta zhes pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa dngos ni/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dge /bdag dag mnyam pa'i tshogs la dbul// bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni// dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim// a la la ste dkyil 'khor thim// zhes pa dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod la/ byang sems mkha' nas blangs lha thams cad kyi ljags la bzhag par mos te/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/

pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dha khā hi/ de nas rak+ta dbal ba ni/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru// zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil// mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas rnams// ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa mā ya mu tra kha kha khā hi khā hi hrīḥ de bi sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ khams gsum yongs su bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ nga ni za byed chen po ste// khams gsum ma lus bsgral bar bya// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya// nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste// dmar chen po yi rgya mtsho bskyil// 'khor ba'i drwa ba gcad pa'i phyir// 'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis// ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang*// zhes pa la sogs pas bstod do// de nas dngos grub blang*/ bar chad zhi bar gsol ba gdab/ ye shes pa dang bcas pa bdag la bsdus te brtan par bya'o// 'di las kyang bsdus pa byed na/ bdag bskyed bsgoms nas/ gtor ma yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du yang snga ma ltar bskyed nas/ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor bsams nas bla med mchog tshig rnams dang*/ chos nyid du spar ba'i bar du'o// de nas mchod pa rnams dang bstod pa bya'o// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sangs rgyas su bsngo/ mdun bskyed bdag la bsdu/ bsrung bar bya'o// rje bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris pa rdzogs so// //bzlas pa'i tshul gsum las/

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sdig sbyong du sngags bzlas pa'o// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ chos nyid skye med du bzlas pa'o// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bzlas pa'o// rgyun gyi man ngag jo mo'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// //snyan brgyud yi ger bris pa rdo rje phur pa'i sngags phra men nyin zhag gcig gis bsrung ba/ zhi rgyas dbang mngon spyod kyi bsrung ba la/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i phur pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du byas pas phur pa'i sku gsung thugs la thim pas phur pa de stod khro bo sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pas phur pa 'dzin pa/ smad phur pa'i dbal dar sngon po'i sham thabs can du bsam/ mchu btsugs la badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// 'gro na lus la bcang*/ nyal na sngas su gzugs par bya'o// sbod gtong dang dgra bgegs la sogs pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa byed pas mi tshugs so// slob dpon pad+mas rnal 'byor pa'i bar chad bsrung ba'i don du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje phur pa gdon drag po 'dul byed ces kyang bya/ gzas pa po kha 'ching ba zhes kyang bya/ bzlas pa khri byas na 'grub par 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ gnod byed sarba bigh+nān badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ a bar ta ya/ dha ro adzñid badz+ra a se ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra a se ṣa hūm̐ a/ snying khrag ku lu nan/ baṃ tsi ta tsi ta gnod byed sogs mā ra ya hūm̐ rbad/ kha ga ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngas su gru gsum mtho gang ba byas la gnod pa'i ming byang bcug la/ khrag dang nyungs kar gyi thun bya/ phur pa brdeg rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la bcol bskul bya/ zhag bdun gyis gdon drag po rnams 'joms/ tsher ma can gyi me la bsreg thal ba gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phang*/ lam du mnan pa bya/ phur pa'i gdon 'dul rdzogs so//

//na mo gu ru/ rdo rje gzhon nu rgyan gyi gdams ngag sangs rgyas lag bcangs kyi dgongs pa/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ sngon po cig bsam/ 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ tshur 'dus rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs lus 'od du song stong par bsam de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ chu'i zla ba ltar gsal la rang bzhin med pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ hūm̐ sngon po rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin de gyur pa las rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi pa dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba bdag 'dra ba cig bsgom/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse dgu pa cig bsgom/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed bkas tsam cig bsgom/ de la hūm̐ pu shud lta bus bsams pa la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas 'bru dgu gser gyi ba thag lta bus bskor ba la/ sngags kyi 'od zer ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gsal/ des ye shes sems dpa' gsal/ des dam tshig sems dpa' gsal/ des sdig pa thams cad dag par bsam zhing bzlas/ stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas so// tshur 'dus bdag la thim/ bdag ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de hūm̐ la/ de ha la/ de mgo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de stong pa 'od gsal cir yang ma grub pa la sems bzhag la sgom bzlas byas pas sdig pa thams cad byang*/ bar chad gdon zhi zhing nad dang rims thams cad dang rkyen glo bur kun bzlog go /tshe 'di la rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'gro/ phyi ma rdo rje gzhon nur bdag gyur ro// slob dpon pad+mas mkhar che bza' 'tsho rgyal la 'bral khar gdams pa'o// snod dang mi ldan pa la mi sbyin no// rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
